authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10066 mārayati gives the mār- kill verb; maral/marla and māryo are ordinary eastern -l and western -y past/infinitive formations. Mār-diyo contains a give light verb and is not assigned as a simple inherited stem. Reviewed comparison: mewati_jhambaus mār “don't kill!, he killed” (f_p6alwpsz4guhw). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6507.2 *dekṣati gives the dekh- see verb and regional v-/d- variation through transmission. Dekh-ta, dekh-u and ordinary -y past forms retain that stem; dekh-liyo requires the take light verb to be analyzed. Reviewed comparison: Dang dekʰnu “he sees; he saw” (f_cxv7xeg25h72u). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.
